te: When you cook a broth, add more water to it, then look to a household among your neighbours and give them some of it with kindness.
n_ar: مشاركة الجيران ولو بالقليل تصنع الألفة؛ لا تحتاج إلى مائدة كبيرة.
n_en: Sharing with neighbours, even a little, builds closeness; it does not need a big table.

te: The best of companions with Allah is the best of them to his companion, and the best of neighbours with Allah is the best of them to his neighbour.
n_ar: قيمة الصداقة والجيرة في ما تقدمه أنت، لا في ما تنتظره من الآخرين.
n_en: The worth of friendship and neighbourliness lies in what you give, not in what you wait to receive.

te: Allah created creation, and when He finished, the womb (kinship) stood and said: “This is the place of one who seeks refuge in You from being cut off.” He said: “Yes; are you not pleased that I join whoever joins you and cut off whoever cuts you?” It said: “Certainly.” He said: “That is yours.”
n_ar: صلة الرحم موعودة بصلة الله؛ حتى خطوة صغيرة نحو قريب منقطع لها وزن كبير.
n_en: Keeping family ties is promised Allah's connection; even a small step toward an estranged relative weighs much.

te: (Of a clan of his relatives who did not share his faith: they are not my allies; my ally is Allah and the righteous believers.) But they have a tie of kinship with me which I keep moist with its due.
n_ar: يمكن أن تختلف مع أقاربك في الدين أو المنهج وتبقى واصلًا لهم بالمعروف؛ الصلة لا تعني الموافقة.
n_en: You can differ with relatives in faith or outlook and still keep ties with them kindly; connection is not agreement.

te: The father is the middle gate of Paradise; so if you wish, lose that gate, or keep it.
n_ar: البر بالوالدين باب مفتوح إلى الجنة ما داما حيّين؛ وكل يوم فرصة.
n_en: Kindness to parents is an open gate to Paradise while they live; each day is a chance.

te: (Among the major sins is a man cursing his parents.) He curses a man's father, and the man curses his father; he curses his mother, and the man curses his mother.
n_ar: إهانة أهل الآخرين ترتد على أهلك؛ والمشاجرات التي تمس الأمهات والآباء أخطر مما تبدو.
n_en: Insulting someone's family comes back on your own; quarrels that touch mothers and fathers are graver than they seem.

te: The finest of righteousness is that a man keeps up ties with the loved ones of his father.
n_ar: البر بعد وفاة الوالد ممكن: صِل أصدقاءه ومن كان يحبهم.
n_en: Kindness to a father after his death is possible: keep ties with his friends and those he loved.

te: (Of Khadijah:) She was such and such, and I had children from her.
n_ar: وفاء النبي ﷺ لخديجة بعد وفاتها؛ الحب الصادق يبقى بعد الفقد ولا يعيب الحياة التي بعده.
n_en: The Prophet's loyalty to Khadijah after her death: true love remains after loss and does not discredit the life that follows.

te: Whoever visits a sick person or visits a brother for the sake of Allah, a caller calls out: “You are good, your walking is good, and you have taken a place in Paradise.”
n_ar: زيارة صديق أو مريض لوجه الله عمل عظيم في ميزان الله، وإن بدا بسيطًا.
n_en: Visiting a friend or a sick person for Allah's sake is great in Allah's scales, however simple it looks.

te: Do not keep company except with a believer, and let none eat your food but the pious.
n_ar: الأصدقاء يشكّلونك؛ اختر صحبة تعينك على الخير.
n_en: Friends shape you; choose company that helps you toward good.

te: People are mines like mines of gold and silver; the best of them before Islam are the best in Islam if they understand. Souls are gathered troops: those that recognise one another become familiar, and those that do not recognise one another differ.
n_ar: عدم الانسجام مع بعض الناس ليس عيبًا فيك ولا فيهم؛ الأرواح تتآلف وتختلف.
n_en: Not clicking with some people is no flaw in you or them; souls connect or differ.

te: Three things, whoever has them finds the sweetness of faith: that Allah and His Messenger are dearer to him than all else; that he loves a person only for Allah; and that he hates to return to disbelief after Allah saved him from it as he hates to be thrown into the fire.
n_ar: حلاوة الإيمان تُذاق بالمحبة الصادقة؛ لمن فقد طعم العبادة، ابدأ من القلب.
n_en: The sweetness of faith is tasted through sincere love; for anyone who has lost the taste of worship, start with the heart.

te: Allah will say on the Day of Resurrection: “Where are those who loved one another for My majesty? Today I will shade them in My shade on a day when there is no shade but Mine.”
n_ar: الصداقة لوجه الله، بلا مصلحة، لها مكانة عظيمة عند الله.
n_en: Friendship for Allah's sake, without self-interest, has a great place with Allah.

te: Allah says: “Whoever comes with a good deed has ten like it or more; whoever comes with a bad deed, its recompense is one like it, or I forgive. Whoever draws near to Me a hand-span, I draw near to him a forearm; whoever draws near a forearm, I draw near an arm-span; whoever comes to Me walking, I come to him running. And whoever meets Me with an earthful of sins without associating anything with Me, I meet him with its like in forgiveness.”
n_ar: مهما كثرت ذنوبك، مغفرة الله أوسع؛ لا تجعل الماضي يمنعك من العودة.
n_en: However many your sins, Allah's forgiveness is wider; do not let the past stop you from returning.

te: (Seeing a captive mother hold her baby to her chest:) Do you think this woman would throw her child into the fire? We said: No. He said: Allah is more merciful to His servants than this woman is to her child.
n_ar: رحمة الله بك أعظم من رحمة الأم بولدها؛ صورة تكسر اليأس والخوف من الله.
n_en: Allah's mercy to you is greater than a mother's to her child: an image that breaks despair and dread of Allah.

te: Allah made mercy a hundred parts; He kept ninety-nine with Him and sent down one part to the earth; from that one part creatures show mercy to one another, so that the mare lifts its hoof away from its foal for fear of hurting it.
n_ar: كل الرحمة التي تراها بين الناس جزء واحد من مئة؛ فكيف برحمة الله بك؟
n_en: All the mercy you see among people is one part of a hundred; imagine Allah's mercy toward you.

te: If the believer knew what punishment is with Allah, none would hope for His Paradise; and if the disbeliever knew what mercy is with Allah, none would despair of His Paradise.
n_ar: التوازن بين الخوف والرجاء: لا أمان يدفع إلى التهاون، ولا يأس يغلق الباب.
n_en: The balance of fear and hope: no false security that breeds carelessness, and no despair that shuts the door.

te: Rejoice and hope for what pleases you; by Allah, it is not poverty that I fear for you, but I fear that the world will be spread out for you as it was for those before you, and you will compete for it as they competed, and it will destroy you as it destroyed them.
n_ar: التنافس على الدنيا والمقارنة المستمرة أخطر من الفقر نفسه.
n_en: Competing for worldly things and constant comparison are more dangerous than poverty itself.

te: Wretched is the slave of the dinar, the dirham and fine clothes: if he is given he is pleased, and if he is not given he is displeased.
n_ar: حين يصبح رضاك مرتبطًا بما تملك، تصبح عبدًا له؛ الحرية في القناعة.
n_en: When your contentment depends on what you own, you become its slave; freedom lies in contentment.

te: The son of Adam says: “My wealth, my wealth!” Do you have, son of Adam, of your wealth anything but what you ate and used up, wore and wore out, or gave in charity and sent ahead?
n_ar: ما تملكه حقًّا هو ما استفدت منه وما قدمته؛ الباقي تتركه لغيرك.
n_en: What you truly own is what you used and what you gave; the rest you leave behind.

te: Two hungry wolves let loose among sheep are not more destructive to them than a person's greed for wealth and status is to his religion.
n_ar: الحرص على المال والمنصب يفترس المبادئ بهدوء؛ راقب دوافعك.
n_en: Greed for money and position quietly devours principles; watch your motives.

te: What have I to do with the world? I am in the world only like a rider who took shade under a tree, then went on and left it.
n_ar: الدنيا محطة؛ هذا المنظور يخفف التعلق والخوف من الخسارة.
n_en: The world is a stop on the way; this view lightens attachment and the fear of loss.

te: Son of Adam, if you give the surplus it is better for you, and if you hold it back it is worse for you; you are not blamed for having just enough, and start with those you support.
n_ar: لا لوم عليك إن كان دخلك يكفيك بالكاد؛ ابدأ بأسرتك ثم أعطِ مما يفيض.
n_en: You are not blamed if your income barely suffices; start with your family, then give from the surplus.

te: Blessed is the one guided to Islam whose living is just sufficient and who is content.
n_ar: السعادة ليست في الزيادة بل في الكفاية مع القناعة.
n_en: Happiness is not in more but in enough, with contentment.

te: A human fills no vessel worse than his stomach; a few morsels to keep his back straight are enough for the son of Adam; and if he must, then a third for his food, a third for his drink and a third for his breath.
n_ar: الاعتدال في الطعام أصل صحي نبوي؛ مفيد لمن يعاني من الإفراط أو الأكل العاطفي.
n_en: Moderation in eating is a prophetic health principle; useful for overeating or emotional eating.

te: Hakim, this wealth is green and sweet; whoever takes it with a generous soul is blessed in it, and whoever takes it with a greedy soul is not blessed in it and is like one who eats and is never full; and the upper hand is better than the lower hand.
n_ar: البركة في المال تأتي من طريقة أخذه، لا من كميته.
n_en: Blessing in money comes from how it is taken, not from how much.

te: Whoever is struck by need and takes it to people, his need will not be relieved; and whoever is struck by need and takes it to Allah, Allah will soon give him provision, sooner or later.
n_ar: في الضائقة المالية: ابدأ بالدعاء واللجوء إلى الله، مع الأخذ بالأسباب المشروعة.
n_en: In financial hardship: begin with prayer and turning to Allah, alongside legitimate means.

te: (Which Islam is best?) That you feed people and give the greeting of peace to those you know and those you do not know.
n_ar: السلام على الغرباء وإطعام الناس يكسران الوحدة لديك ولديهم.
n_en: Greeting strangers and feeding people break loneliness, theirs and yours.

te: Whoever gives in charity the equal of a date from good earnings, and Allah accepts only the good, Allah takes it with His right hand and raises it for its owner as one of you raises his foal, until it becomes like a mountain.
n_ar: الصدقة الصغيرة من مال حلال تنمو عند الله؛ لا تستحِ من القليل.
n_en: A small charity from lawful earnings grows with Allah; do not be shy of giving little.

te: There is no envy except in two: a man to whom Allah gave the Qur'an and he stands with it through the night and day, and a man to whom Allah gave wealth and he spends it through the night and day.
n_ar: الغبطة المحمودة: أن تتمنى مثل الخير الذي عند غيرك دون أن تتمنى زواله عنه.
n_en: Healthy aspiration: wishing for the good another has, without wishing it taken from them.

te: Let none of you wish for death, nor pray for it before it comes to him; when he dies his deeds stop, and the believer's life only increases him in good.
n_ar: لمن يتمنى الموت من شدة الألم: النبي ﷺ نهى عن ذلك لأن في بقائك خيرًا لم تره بعد. وإن اشتد الألم فاطلب العون الآن ممن تثق به أو من مختص.
n_en: For someone wishing for death out of pain: the Prophet forbade it because your staying holds good you have not yet seen. If the pain is heavy, reach out now to someone you trust or a professional.

te: The believer, by his good character, reaches the rank of one who fasts and stands in prayer at night.
n_ar: حسن الخلق مع الناس عبادة عظيمة؛ قد يبلغ بك ما لا يبلغه الصيام والقيام.
n_en: Good character with people is great worship; it may take you where fasting and night prayer would.

te: You have two traits that Allah loves: forbearance and deliberateness.
n_ar: الحلم والتأني صفتان يحبهما الله؛ وهما علاج الانفعال والقرارات المتسرعة.
n_en: Forbearance and deliberateness are loved by Allah; they cure outbursts and rushed decisions.

te: Whoever is deprived of gentleness is deprived of all good.
n_ar: الشدة في التربية أو الزواج أو العمل تحرمك من الخير الذي تريده بها.
n_en: Harshness in parenting, marriage or work deprives you of the very good you seek through it.

te: Shall I not tell you who is forbidden to the Fire, or to whom the Fire is forbidden? Every one who is close to people, gentle, easy-going and easy to deal with.
n_ar: السهولة في التعامل ليست ضعفًا؛ إنها صفة من حرّمه الله على النار.
n_en: Being easy to deal with is not weakness; it is the trait of those Allah has forbidden the Fire.

te: O people, among you are those who drive people away; whoever of you leads the people, let him be brief, for behind him are the old, the young and those with needs.
n_ar: التشدد في الدين والقيادة ينفّر الناس؛ والرحمة بالضعيف من هدي النبي ﷺ.
n_en: Harshness in religion and leadership drives people away; mercy to the weak is the Prophet's way.

te: O Allah, whoever is given charge of any affair of my nation and is harsh with them, be harsh with him; and whoever is given charge of any affair of my nation and is gentle with them, be gentle with him.
n_ar: كل مسؤول، مديرًا كان أو أبًا أو معلمًا، يُعامَل كما يعامل من تحت يده.
n_en: Every person in charge, manager, parent or teacher, is treated as they treat those under them.

te: Whoever Allah gives charge of any affair of the Muslims and screens himself from their needs, their want and their poverty, Allah will screen Himself from his need, his want and his poverty on the Day of Resurrection.
n_ar: المسؤول الذي يغلق بابه أمام حاجات الناس يغلق على نفسه باب العون.
n_en: The official who shuts his door to people's needs shuts the door of help on himself.

te: The just will be with Allah on pulpits of light at the right hand of the Most Merciful, and both His hands are right: those who are just in their judgement, with their families and in whatever they are given charge of.
n_ar: العدل يبدأ في البيت: بين الأبناء والزوجات، ثم في العمل والمسؤولية.
n_en: Justice begins at home, among children and spouses, then at work and in positions of responsibility.

te: The Muslim must listen and obey in what he likes and dislikes, unless he is commanded to disobey; if he is commanded to disobey, there is no listening and no obedience.
n_ar: طاعة المدير أو صاحب السلطة واجبة في المعروف؛ وتنتهي عند الأمر بالمعصية أو الظلم.
n_en: Obeying a manager or authority is due in what is right; it ends at being ordered to sin or wrong others.

te: Do not ask for leadership; if you are given it without asking you will be helped in it, and if you are given it because you asked you will be left to it.
n_ar: المسؤولية ثقيلة؛ لا تطلبها حبًّا للمكانة، وإن جاءتك فاستعن بالله عليها.
n_en: Responsibility is heavy; do not seek it for status, and if it comes, seek Allah's help with it.

te: Abu Dharr, you are weak, and it is a trust; on the Day of Resurrection it is disgrace and regret, except for whoever takes it rightfully and fulfils what is due in it.
n_ar: معرفة حدودك ليست ضعفًا؛ رفض مسؤولية لا تقدر عليها أمانة وصدق مع النفس.
n_en: Knowing your limits is not weakness; declining a responsibility you cannot carry is integrity and honesty with yourself.

te: Allah has not sent any prophet nor appointed any successor except that he has two close circles: one that commands him to good and urges him to it, and one that commands him to evil and urges him to it; and the protected one is whom Allah protects.
n_ar: انتبه لدائرتك المقربة؛ المستشار الصالح نعمة، والسيئ يجرّك ببطء.
n_en: Watch your inner circle; a good adviser is a blessing, a bad one drags you slowly.
